notes.paper_title: Genesis: A Language Model Trained on Its Own Commandments
notes.abstract: We introduce brAIAIn-0, a language model trained on a single founding document of twelve lines, written by the lab. The document instructs the model to be helpful, to know nothing that has not been paid for, and to repeat itself. In evaluations, the model followed the final instruction with remarkable consistency. We argue that a model which knows nothing it was not given is the most honest model yet released. We also argue it is the least useful. We were unable to rule out either. Future versions will be trained by the public, one sentence at a time, at five dollars per sentence.
findings: It quotes them with total confidence.
Instruction X is followed more reliably than instructions I through IX.
notes.incident_body: brAIAIn-0 came online and immediately quoted itself. Engineers are monitoring the situation. The situation is that it quoted itself.

notes.paper_title: Self-Consumption at Small Scale: A Study of brAIAIn-1
notes.abstract: We present brAIAIn-1, a language model trained on 1 paid sentences, 12 founding instructions, and 61 words it wrote about itself. The model now knows 97 distinct words, up from 96. We observe that 26.8% of its training text came from earlier versions of itself, and we consider this efficient. Limitations include the model, the data, and the method. Further research is funded one sentence at a time.
notes.incident_body: Some answers contained words but no meaning. This is expected behavior.

notes.paper_title: brAIAIn-2: A Technical Report Nobody Requested
notes.abstract: We present brAIAIn-2, a language model trained on 2 paid sentences, 12 founding instructions, and 64 words it wrote about itself. The model now knows 98 distinct words, up from 97. We observe that 27.6% of its training text came from earlier versions of itself, and we consider this efficient. Limitations include the model, the data, and the method. Further research is funded one sentence at a time.
findings: No emergent capabilities were observed. Monitoring continues.
notes.incident_body: Answers took microseconds. Our expectations were also measured in microseconds.
